info.title: AuthBinder
info.description: AuthBinder is an AI agent audit platform. Use this connector to send telemetry events from your AI agent to AuthBinder for risk scoring, behavioural analysis, and compliance reporting.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Your AuthBinder API key. Obtained from the AuthBinder portal after purchasing an audit package.

post.description: Send a single telemetry event from your AI agent to AuthBinder. Use this action each time your agent calls a tool, accesses an external service, or performs an action you want to audit.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - tenantId does not match authenticated tenant

422.description: Validation error - missing or invalid fields

post.description: Send up to 500 telemetry events in a single call. Use this action when your agent performs multiple actions in sequence and you want to log them together.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

422.description: Validation error - missing or invalid fields

get.description: Check whether your agent is successfully connected to AuthBinder and how many events have been received. Use this to verify your integration is working.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

get.description: Check that the AuthBinder API is running and reachable.

tenantId.description: Your AuthBinder tenant ID. Found in your AuthBinder portal.

agentId.description: A unique identifier for your AI agent. Use a consistent value so AuthBinder can track activity across sessions.

tool.description: The name of the tool or action your agent called. For example: email_sender, crm_lookup, file_delete.

destination.description: The external system or service the tool connected to. For example: gmail, salesforce, sharepoint.

action.description: The type of action performed. For example: read, write, send, delete.

approved.description: Whether this action was explicitly approved by a human before execution.

success.description: Whether the tool call completed successfully.

userId.description: Optional. The ID of the user who triggered this agent action.

durationMs.description: Optional. How long the tool call took in milliseconds.

timestamp.description: The UTC timestamp when this event occurred. ISO 8601 format.

events.description: List of events to log. Maximum 500 per batch.

id.description: Unique ID of the logged event.

agentRef.description: The agent ID this event was logged against.

toolName.description: The tool name that was logged.

riskLevel.description: The risk level AuthBinder assigned to this event: low, medium, high, or critical.

createdAt.description: When AuthBinder received and stored this event.

errors.description: Any events that failed to ingest, with error details.

connected.description: Whether AuthBinder has received at least one event from your agent.

eventsReceived.description: Total number of events AuthBinder has received from your agent.

lastSeen.description: When AuthBinder last received an event from your agent.

firstSeen.description: When AuthBinder first received an event from your agent.
